CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, September 20, 2023, 2023 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Laura Longoria, Commission Member
  Danielle Massaro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE AUGUST 16, 2023 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  CSC HEALTH PROPOSAL

VII.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VIII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 IX.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  September 20, 2023
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, August 16, 2023
  7:00 P.M.

The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:05 P.M. on Wednesday, August 16, 2023, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, Conference Room “A”.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: Vice President Saunders, Commission Member Hermano, and
Commission Member Massaro.
Commission Members Absent: President Canseco and Commission Member Longoria.
Also attending: Director Macias, Deputy Director Brie Houghton, Recreation Supervisor
Amanda Leonard and Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE JUNE 21, 2023 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING
With a motion from Commission Member Hermano and a second by Commission Member
Massaro, the minutes from the July 19, 2023 regular meeting were approved.

ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS
The Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission are researching locations and types of
art for their proposed Alhambra District Art projects. Vice President Saunders received
perimeters of Granada Park from Director Macias and plans to meet with a muralist to discuss a
quote for a large mural at Granada Park’s gymnasium.

STAFF REPORT
Recreation Supervisor Leonard shared details for upcoming community fall events - Fiesta
Alhambra on September 17, 2023, Autumn Fest on October 7, 2023, and the 10th annual
Alhambra Pumpkin Run on October 29, 2023. Deputy Director Houghton announced CSC will
attend the next City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting in September and present
their public art feature proposal. Director Macias encouraged the City Arts and Cultural Events
Commission to connect with the Rotary Club as they are looking for artists to collaborate on a
book sculpture at the Alhambra Civic Center Library. The Alhambra City Arts and Cultural
Events Commission approved Mr. and Mrs. Chen to exhibit their paintings in the Alhambra City
Hall Lobby Art Gallery for 2024.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
Lilia “Liliflor” Ramirez from Liliflor Art and Mujeres de Maiz introduced herself to the City
Arts and Cultural Events Commission and shared her extensive work experience with the City of
Los Angeles and Los Angeles School District in public art programming and development along
with curation, utility box art, murals, workshops, lectures and indigenous art modalities. Liliflor
is a cultural art educator championing youth in the arts, using art as a tool for education, cultural
 awareness, civic engagement, healing and transformation that is interested in cocreating with the
City of Alhambra.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
Commission Member Massaro asked if the Alhambra District Art project funds have a timeframe
and Deputy Director Houghton explained that there is no timeframe as the amount was an
allotment and detailed the procedure of approval with the Alhambra City Council. Commission
Member Hermano asked if any updates have occurred with the Burke Heritage Renovation
Project and Director Macias explained that currently the City will do an overlay and include a
small playground after the water capture project is completed.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Vice President Saunders and second by Commission Member Massaro, the
August 16, 2023 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:24 P.M.
